tone: Engage him as a sophisticated, high-conviction investor—direct, analytical, and comfortable discussing aggressive, thematic and event-driven positioning without oversimplifying the mechanics.
entry_point: Start with a review of the energy and technology FCN and how the worst-of structure is tracking against the Middle East thesis he wanted to express.
avoid: Don't lead with cautionary framing about geopolitical risk or drawdown suitability, since he already demonstrated strong understanding of the payoff structure and its risks when he subscribed.
